result_summary.title: Analytics Dashboard performance degradation and intermittent failures
result_summary.description:
Users are reporting that the Analytics Dashboard in the US-West production environment is becoming very slow to load. We are also seeing intermittent failures where the dashboard simply fails to render data or times out completely. 

We are confident this is purely a capacity limitation issue. Our traffic has increased slightly, and it seems the dashboard servers are just maxed out and cannot handle the current load. Please provision more resources or scale up the backend to resolve this bottleneck. Note that no specific business impact metrics are available, and user count errors are currently showing 0, but the performance lag is noticeable.
